crossRefs.note: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed…
Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I…
Then Deborah and Barak the son of Abinoam sang on that day, saying,
Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.
Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned…
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has…
Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
